title: Carrying Capacity and Population Growth Assessment Exam
description: Checkpoint assessment for Carrying Capacity and Population Growth.

questions.question: A lake supports 500 fish for several years, but after pollution reduces oxygen, it supports only 300. What changed?
options: the population became a new species
questions.explanation: Lower oxygen reduces supportable population size.

questions.question: Which graph shape usually represents logistic growth?
A population that rises above carrying capacity has experienced an ________.
Competition generally increases as population density increases.
questions.explanation: More individuals compete for limited resources.

questions.question: Explain how drought can change carrying capacity.
questions.correctAnswer: Drought can reduce water and plant growth, lowering food and water availability, so the ecosystem supports fewer organisms.
questions.explanation: The answer should connect drought to limiting resources.

questions.question: Which is a density-dependent limiting factor?
options: disease spreading faster in crowded populations
a volcanic eruption destroying habitat suddenly
a single storm unrelated to population density
questions.explanation: Disease often spreads more easily at high density.

questions.question: A bacteria culture grows rapidly, then levels off. Explain why.
questions.correctAnswer: Nutrients and space become limited and wastes build up, so reproduction slows and deaths may increase.
questions.explanation: The answer should identify limiting factors.

questions.question: Which statement is most accurate?
options: Carrying capacity can change over time.
Carrying capacity is always the same everywhere.

questions.question: Predators can be a limiting factor for prey populations.
The largest population an ecosystem can support over time is its carrying ________.
Describe the difference between rapid growth and slowing growth on an S-shaped curve.
questions.correctAnswer: Rapid growth occurs when resources are abundant; slowing growth occurs near carrying capacity as limiting factors increase.
questions.explanation: The answer should compare resource conditions.

questions.question: Which management action could raise carrying capacity for a pond fish population?
options: adding unlimited fish with no food
questions.explanation: Better habitat can increase supportable population size.
